_doc: Catalog silos: focused views over the one dataset, each for an audience and a job. A silo is a set of sections (which may cross product families), the table columns that audience scans first, and the decision tools, research views and exports that apply to it. Records are never removed or duplicated: the Atlas (the home table) shows every row and every column; a silo shows its rows and its columns. Edit this file to add or change a silo; the web app, the exports and llms.txt read it. Section names must match taxonomy/families.json.
